Plot the posterior similarity of items or rankings

Source: R/plot_common_fit.R
plot_posterior_similarity.Rd

Cell \((i, j)\) shows \(\Pr(z_i = z_j \mid y)\), the proportion of draws in which the two entities share a latent group. The plot is label-invariant, which makes it safer to interpret than raw MCMC labels.

Usage

plot_posterior_similarity(
  fit,
  target = c("item", "ranking"),
  order_rows = TRUE,
  show_blocks = TRUE,
  show_values = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

A btsbm_fit object containing an item or ranking partition.

target

Whether to plot latent groups of "item" or "ranking".

order_rows

Whether to reorder rows and columns for display.

show_blocks

Outline the blocks of the point estimate (items only).

show_values

Print probabilities in cells; defaults to TRUE for at most 20 entities.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

For item partitions, rows are ordered by the point estimate of the partition (blocks outlined, block 1 strongest). Values below one inside an outlined block do not mean the items move to another block: in a given draw the block may simply be split into finer sub-blocks. Use block_stability() to see whether the missing mass goes to splitting or to merging.
